method.overview: All 45 full_zh and 7 brief_zh visual_samples listed in qa.json were actually viewed in ten labelled contact sheets using view_image.
method.enlarged_review: The 25 listed full_zh pages and all seven brief_zh pages were additionally viewed as individual PDF renders at approximately 1012 by 1432 pixels. Dense matrices, table cells, repeated table headers, page transitions and long reference URLs were inspected visually.
method.scope_limit: This is visual review of the listed 45 full-report sample pages, not a claim to have visually reviewed all 222 full-report pages. All seven brief-report pages were visually reviewed. Machine bounds, navigation and preservation checks are separate in qa.json.
method.hash_binding: Both PDF SHA-256 values were recomputed after the actual visual inspection and matched the reviewed artifacts.

observations: No material clipping, overflow, overlap, missing glyphs or unreadable table cells were observed in reviewed pages.
The scenario and technology-versus-recovery matrices were legible; watermarks did not obscure their content.
Tables crossing full-report pages 147-148, 159-160, 166-167 and 168-169 retained aligned columns and repeated headers; inspected rows were not visibly cut through.
Reviewed contents, chapter openings, headers, footers, page numbers and reference URL wrapping were orderly.
